Z now uses the 4× printed-leadscrew actuator with a full-depth NEMA17 and 40 mm travel. Its cradle retains printed 2× holes and inferred T8 2×/4× mounting patterns. The inverted 1× radial actuator keeps a full-depth NEMA14 and 120 mm travel; its underside carrier accepts both printed-screw and T8 lid patterns. T8 widened patterns are inferred, not released designs. Mounting coordinates

The wider output flange uses eight M3 screws, with additional 2× holes. The radial screw, guide and housing are lengthened to preserve full 100 × 100 mm PCB coverage. Pivots are now 350 mm from board center on a 900 × 900 mm platform. The radial motor body remains centered over the Z screw axis. Both linear screws have an 8 mm lead; actual accuracy and load capacity remain untested.

The shared rotary base is unchanged: 12/72 teeth, four tilted 625ZZ rollers, lightened base and deck, and a slotted Ø15.25 mm central spindle for the 6002 bearings. Right-click to download, isolate, hide or show all parts and toggle hidden edges.

Green translucent volumes reserve space for the rear controller components and USB cables. Component height, spacers and cables are provisional allowances. Load capacity, stiffness, contact force, print fit and accuracy remain untested. The checked module explosion separates one arm, removes the radial bottom-mount screws, and separates the new actuator modules. Actuator drives stay assembled; switch to Four arms for coordinated probing.

Based on FLEX, compliant-spur-gear, and the RP2040 motor controller.
